question: If 'TERMINATES' is coded as 'JNSFUTFUBO' and 'TOWERS' is coded as 'XPUTSF', then how will 'MOVEMENT be coded in the same code?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2775864c411b7b7effeab2b3c0808ee3cbf3ef1c3cedf2a7c11a799aea2bcd2e.png] 

The logic follows here is:

 
• **'TERMINATES' is coded as 'JNSFUTFUBO'​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d100acde84e5cfdec4deebdfbda62139068b8ffe2abdada76b091bd14aa31276.png] 

and

 
• **'TOWERS' is coded as 'XPUTSF'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f575be0b8b3c4ca681251d1ffceb9251ffd895172eab56638ba3e3e9970b57e6.png] ​

similarly,

 
• ** 'MOVEMENT' will be coded as:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff29e546e1bf2853bf7031f8081bd4361186fdb84a7c15ed0b912b290fa8456b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**FWPNUOFN**".
